newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil steady on IPE, despite weaker premiums.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil steady on IPE, despite weaker premiums.

text.p: NWE gas oil was steady on Tuesday propped up by stronger IPE futures which countered the downward pull of premiums.
Heating oil barges were the only real gainer as premiums held and prices were boosted by futures.
April IPE gas oil last traded at $172.25, $1.50 a tonne stronger.
Russian cargo premiums fell from April IPE +$2-4 cif NWE to April IPE +$1-2 cif with a 20,000 tonne cargo sold at April IPE +$1.85 cif NWE, even though traders said supplies remained tight.
"The whole gas oil complex looks to be drifting down," said one trader. The larger Russian cargoes were still expected to head to eastwards with the arb likely to work into April for May arrivals.

DIN premiums were also thought to have eased, despite unchanged bids of April IPE +$5 cif Germany. A 20kt cargo was offered at April +$4 cif Hamburg or Bremen while a 20kt cargo was available at April IPE +$3 cif Hamburg.
